rca of the issue: Original CI failure: dompurify (^3.4.12) + @types/dompurify (^3.2.0) were added on 2025-07-29 as an XSS security fix but yarn.lock was never regenerated/committed, so `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` in GitHub Actions failed. Additionally @types/dompurify@3.2.0 is a stub (dompurify ships its own types since v3). Mitigation applied by main agent (verified here): `yarn remove @types/dompurify` + regenerate yarn.lock. Post-fix: frozen install passes both warm (0.3s) and cold-cache (22.76s in isolated dir), typecheck passes, app serves 200.
